objective: Show a Confluence editor turning an empty Mini-Site macro into a live, multi-file static site without leaving Confluence or configuring separate hosting.
audience: Confluence admins and Marketplace evaluators deciding whether Mini Site for Confluence solves 'host a small site without leaving Confluence'.

evidence.description: The proven end-to-end Playwright spec this story's flow mirrors: create page, open macro, publish a bundle, assert the live preview.
Sample bundle entry point (index.html). Its own body literally reads 'Mini-Site is live' — the exact text the final scene proves is being served.
Sample bundle script, uploaded alongside index.html to make the bundle genuinely multi-file.
Sample bundle stylesheet, uploaded alongside index.html to make the bundle genuinely multi-file.

narration.script: Here's a normal Confluence page with an empty Mini Site macro — nothing published yet.
Open the publisher, select a multi-file bundle, and publish it — no build step, no separate hosting to configure.
And the mini-site is live, served straight out of the page it was published from.
